alignments.note: One substantive rendered by a multi-word English phrase; headed on *empty*, which carries the lexeme, under rule 31, with the indefinite article going to the nominal expression under rule 15. The ASV italic on *cry* corroborates that the noun is supplied, by rule 7.
Finite verb with its auxiliary; discontinuous around the negative under rule 25.

Waw plus the negative of the second line rendered by the single *Neither*, which carries both the coordination and the negation; rule 35's fusion, headed on the negative under rule 23. Distance across the intervening subject does not break it.
Divine title with the supplied *the* joining the nominal expression under rule 15.
Finite verb with its auxiliary, headed on the lexical verb.

review_notes: The *Neither* fusion is preferred to giving the word to the waw alone, since the negative morpheme is written in that line and rule 35 requires the single word to carry every morpheme's sense placed in it.
